ns2:section.sectionText: This course is intended for non-thesis M.S. students who find they need additional support in completing their capstone project. To request permission to enroll, please email Piper Hodson (phodson@illinois.edu). This course requires each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu.
